label: RUCKUS ICX 7150-C08P
description: RUCKUS ICX 7150-C08P fanless compact switch: 8x 1G PoE+ RJ-45 (62 W budget) and 2x 1G SFP uplinks. No stacking, no local console and no out-of-band management port.

poe.note: 62 W across 8 PoE+ ports (hardware guide model table, column PoE Power).

notes: Hardware guide model table: 8x1G copper, 8 PoE ports, 62 W, 2x1G fibre optic uplinks (uplink only), no stacking. Datasheet: 8x 10/100/1000 Mbps PoE+ RJ-45, 2x 1GbE SFP uplink, 62 W PoE power budget, fanless. This is the one 7150 with no local management hardware: the guide states the C08P and C08PT have no out-of-band management port, no RJ-45 console and no USB, so no mgmt port and no console port are modelled - management is in-band over the network only, which is why the CLI capability is kept while the console port is not invented. The two uplinks are named sfp1/sfp2 because the guide publishes their count and rate but not their slot/port numbers, and writing 1/3/1-1/3/2 would be a guess. The SFP uplinks are 1G only - there is no 10G option on this model.
